items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: on the show I don't have to tell you it was Peg Leg Bates, Timmie Rodgers, Patteson and Jackson, just all heavy weights in show business.

ctx.x: incidentally, Sarah was with this show, and Jimmie Jones was her accompaniest, and he just haunted Duke and Stray Horn. Little did I realize the direction he was taking, you know, because he just adored them, you know, he admired them so. But this was a great band.

Louie Bellson was so exciting, they couldn't get anybody but Nat to follow him. Listen, he was so exciting really, and on the show I don't have to tell you it was Peg Leg Bates, Timmie Rodgers, Patteson and Jackson, just all heavy weights in show business. But nobody could follow Louie Bellson but Nat.
